Avoid
Aug 2024 • Friends
It's a noisy nightclub where a fair number of tipsy, loaded local businessmen and a few tourists watch dance routines on stage. It's not bad. Someone has spent money on the place. But the low scale rip-offs are so demeaning. The price for your beer is OK and food is over-priced, which is to be expected. But the bill is supplemented with ridiculous and downright insulting charges for a small bowl of peanuts, which were not asked for (and usually served complimentary to make the customers drink more). But not at Sparta. The nuts were charged. However, the worst petty scam is that Sparta charged for napkins! What kind of place charges for a napkin with your meal? That is pathetic. There are so many better places in Hanoi.

Awesome Beer Club
Aug 2018 • Friends
During recent trip to Hanoi, local colleague brought me to this beer club. I am not much of a beer drinker but I must say that the place was fantastic. The music was great. Not deafening loud that you could not have a conversation. Staff was SUPER helpful and very much customer oriented. But the one thing that I must comment on was the variety of absolutely wonderful food that could be ordered - absolutely delicious and freshly prepared. On the stage, starting from 8:30 PM, beautiful dancers. Aside from "towers" of beer, one could order any type of drink you could think of. 

The price was extremely reasonable!!

I give Sparta a 10+ rating!! I definitely will return there on my next trip to Hanoi.

REALLY BAD
Jan 2018 • Solo
Nice place at first impression. You will order a beer (about 40.000vnd) and they will bring you the beer. They will also bring you a bowl of peanuts and a wet napkin. They will open the wet napkin in front of you and leave the peanuts on the table. When you ask for the bill it will be around 100.000vnd. The reason? You have to pay for the peanuts and the napkin, EVEN THAT YOU NEVER ORDERED IT and NOBODY TOLD YOU THE PRICE OF IT. If you claim they will say that their staff is new and they don't know how to explain to you that peanuts and napkins are not on the house, as they looked like. BE CAREFUL with that practice and refuse their "gift" when they bring it to your table if you don't want to pay an extra in your bill.
